# Wait for next target to spawn - stay in place and check
# Press DOWN a few times to advance time without moving much

for i in range(10):
    result = action(['DOWN'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    player = None
    targets = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'O': player = n
        elif n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] == 3: targets.append(n)
    
    red_squares = sum(1 for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'R')
    
    if targets:
        for t in targets:
            t_cols = sorted([b[1] for b in t['boundary']])
            t_rows = sorted([b[0] for b in t['boundary']])
            print(f"Step {current_frame.step}: NEW TARGET cols {t_cols[0]}-{t_cols[-1]}, rows {t_rows[0]}-{t_rows[-1]}")
            if player:
                p_cols = sorted([b[1] for b in player['boundary']])
                p_rows = sorted([b[0] for b in player['boundary']])
                print(f"  Player: cols {p_cols[0]}-{p_cols[-1]}, rows {p_rows[0]}-{p_rows[-1]}")
    
    if red_squares < 1:
        print(f"Step {current_frame.step}: ALL TARGETS COLLECTED!")
        break
    
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print(f"Step {current_frame.step}: LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break

if not any(n['color'] == 'N' and n['pixels'] == 3 for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']):
    print(f"Step {current_frame.step}: No targets visible yet")
    if player:
        p_cols = sorted([b[1] for b in player['boundary']])
        p_rows = sorted([b[0] for b in player['boundary']])
        print(f"Player: cols {p_cols[0]}-{p_cols[-1]}, rows {p_rows[0]}-{p_rows[-1]}")

</function>
</tool_call>
